name: Scopa d'Assi
description: Scopa d'Assi is an Italian fishing game and variant of Scopa. Like Asso Pigliatutto, an Ace captures all table cards; unlike that variant, clearing the table with an Ace does not count as a sweep (scopa). Play and scoring match basic Scopa: capture by matching value or sum, score for sweeps, most cards, most coins, settebello, and primiera. Often played by four in partnerships with 9 or 10 cards each (Scopone style), or with optional Napola points.
